prompt: Which statements about GitHub account types are correct? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Personal accounts are identities; organizations are shared owners with teams; enterprises centralize policy and billing across organizations — and members are always personal accounts. Any account type, including personal ones, can own public repositories.

options.text: A personal account is your individual identity on GitHub
An organization can own repositories and group members into teams
An organization signs in through one shared account that everyone uses
An enterprise manages multiple organizations under one owner
